title: 4x4 Box Breathing
one_line_why: Balances autonomic tone and dampens acute sympathetic stress in 3 minutes.
steps: Inhale through nose for 4 counts
Hold with lungs full for 4 counts
Slow exhale through mouth for 4 counts
Hold empty for 4 counts. Repeat 4 cycles.
caution_note: If you feel lightheaded, resume normal breathing immediately.

title: Dual Inhale Physiological Sigh
one_line_why: Fastest biological mechanism to trigger vagal parasympathetic recovery.
steps: Take two deep inhales through your nose (one deep, followed immediately by a sharp top-up)
Exhale slowly and fully through your mouth with a soft sigh
Repeat 3 to 5 times at your own pace
caution_note: Do not force your breath if you have respiratory discomfort.

title: Cold Water Electrolyte Reset
one_line_why: Replenishes micro-cellular hydration to counter cognitive sluggishness.
steps: Step away from your desk to the water station
Slowly drink 250-350ml of cool water
Splash cool water lightly on your face or wrists before sitting back
caution_note: Sip slowly; avoid gulping freezing water too rapidly.

title: Natural Daylight Eye Reset
one_line_why: Stimulates retinal ganglion cells to suppress melatonin and elevate alertness.
steps: Walk to a bright window or step onto a balcony
Look toward natural daylight (do NOT look directly into the sun)
Let your eyes relax into a panoramic field of view for 3 minutes
caution_note: Never stare directly at the sun.

title: Doorframe Chest & Spine Stretch
one_line_why: Reverses postural kyphosis and opens diaphragm for deeper respiratory oxygenation.
steps: Stand inside a doorway and place forearms flat on the frame
Step one foot forward until you feel a gentle chest stretch
Hold for 30 seconds with calm nasal breathing
Switch leading foot and repeat
caution_note: Gentle stretch only; do not strain shoulders or lower back.

title: 5-Minute Corridor Stride
one_line_why: Activates calf muscle pumps to boost cerebral blood flow and clear mental fog.
steps: Leave your phone and screen at your desk
Walk briskly down the corridor, hallway, or around the block
Keep eyes forward and allow arms to swing naturally
caution_note: Wear stable footwear.

title: Single-Tab Sensory Lockdown
one_line_why: Eliminates attentional residue caused by continuous peripheral distractions.
steps: Close or minimize all background windows and notification drawers
Keep exactly ONE working document or tab visible on screen
Put your mobile phone facedown out of arm's reach for the next sprint
caution_note: Bookmark critical work before closing tabs.

title: 2-Minute Cognitive Offload
one_line_why: Unburdens working memory by transferring looping open loops to physical paper.
steps: Take a blank piece of paper and a pen
Jot down every unfinished thought, worry, or pending chore in 120 seconds
Draw a box around only the single next step you will tackle
caution_note: Write freely; do not organize or format while writing.

title: Acoustic Masking Calibration
one_line_why: Masks unpredictable ambient frequency spikes that trigger micro-arousals.
steps: Put on headphones with brown noise or low-frequency ambient drone
Set volume to a gentle 50% background level
Work with the soundscape for the upcoming focus window
caution_note: Keep volume at a safe, moderate listening level.

title: 60-Second Human Connection
one_line_why: Quick prosocial interaction releases oxytocin to reset isolation fatigue.
steps: Send a quick 1-line message of gratitude or encouragement to a colleague or friend
Or share a brief 30-second pleasant check-in with someone nearby
Return to your task feeling grounded
caution_note: Keep it to a micro-ping; avoid diving into long discussions.

title: Trapezius & Neck Release
one_line_why: Dissolves isometric muscle contraction caused by intense screen hunching.
steps: Inhale and lift your shoulders up toward your ears
Roll them backward and down in a wide circular arc
Perform 8 backward rolls followed by 8 forward rolls
Gently tilt your head ear-to-shoulder for 10s each side
caution_note: Never jerk or force neck motions.

title: 20-20-20 Ciliary Muscle Release
one_line_why: Relieves eye accommodation spasms caused by persistent close-range focus.
steps: Direct your gaze away from your screen
Focus on an object at least 20 feet (6 meters) away
Hold your gaze there for a full 20 seconds while blinking softly
caution_note: Blink naturally to restore corneal moisture.

title: 10-Minute Zero-Input Rest
one_line_why: Flushes synaptic adenosine accumulation after sleep debt without entering slow-wave sleep.
steps: Set an alarm for exactly 10 minutes
Close your eyes and lean back comfortably with lights dimmed
Allow thoughts to drift without engaging your phone or audio
caution_note: Cap at 10-12 minutes to avoid sleep inertia grogginess.

title: Atomic Next-Step Downscale
one_line_why: Overcomes task paralysis by reducing threshold activation energy.
steps: Look at your blocked project
Shrink the very next step until it feels embarrassingly easy (e.g., 'type one sentence' or 'open the file')
Commit to doing just that 60-second slice
caution_note: Focus exclusively on the immediate micro-step.

title: Stand-Up Position Switch
one_line_why: Shifts metabolic rate and activates postural stabilizing motor units.
steps: Elevate your standing desk, or move your laptop to a high counter
Stand with balanced weight across both feet
Work in this upright position for your next 20-minute block
caution_note: Shift weight periodically; avoid locking knees.

title: Pre-Meeting 3-Breath Buffer
one_line_why: Clears mental carryover between back-to-back calendar transitions.
steps: Mute audio and close previous meeting notes
Take 3 deliberate, slow belly breaths
Set a single clear intention for what you need to achieve in the incoming session
caution_note: Focus on the transition rather than past agendas.

title: Warm Uncaffeinated Tea Sip
one_line_why: Warm sensory input triggers digestive relaxation without adding caffeine jitters.
steps: Brew or pour a mug of warm herbal tea (chamomile, peppermint) or warm water
Hold the warm mug in both hands for 30 seconds
Take small, measured warm sips while breathing slowly
caution_note: Ensure beverage is warm, not scalding hot.

title: Room CO2 Ventilation Flush
one_line_why: Reduces indoor CO2 accumulation which directly impairs cognitive decision-making.
steps: Open opposite windows or propping the door open to generate cross-breeze
Allow fresh outdoor air to circulate through your workspace for 3 minutes
Take 5 deep breaths of fresh air
caution_note: Adjust if external air quality is hazardous.

title: Carpal & Forearm Tendon Floss
one_line_why: Alleviates flexor tendon strain from continuous keyboard and trackpad clutching.
steps: Extend your arm forward with palm facing up; gently draw fingers back with opposite hand for 15s
Flip palm facing down and gently stretch back of wrist for 15s
Shake out both wrists gently like flicking water off fingers
caution_note: Gentle tension only, never force pain.

title: 60-Second Visual Clutter Purge
one_line_why: Reduces sub-conscious visual sensory clutter competing for executive processing.
steps: Remove empty cups, food wrappers, and extraneous papers from immediate eye line
Place current focus tools in clean alignment
Enjoy the visual calm before beginning work
caution_note: Limit to 60 seconds; do not fall into deep cleaning procrastination.

title: Quiet Screen-Free Stillness
one_line_why: Lets default mode network quiet down without stimulus consumption.
steps: Turn off monitor or push screen lid down halfway
Sit comfortably with hands in lap in silence
Notice your breath for 90 seconds without looking at any device
caution_note: Relax muscles without slouching.

title: Top-3 Priority Lockdown
one_line_why: Resolves cognitive overload from ambiguous, sprawling to-do lists.
steps: Write down the single task that matters most before day's end
Write two secondary bonus tasks
Cross off or hide everything else until tomorrow
caution_note: Be ruthless; only 1 primary task.

title: Acoustic Silence Pod
one_line_why: Instantly drops auditory processing load in noisy dorms or open offices.
steps: Insert foam earplugs or enable active noise cancellation without music
Adjust fit until ambient murmur is completely suppressed
Enjoy 15 minutes of uninterrupted silence
caution_note: Ensure you remain aware of emergency audio signals if in public.

title: 2-Minute Progressive Muscle Scan
one_line_why: Reconnects mind-body sensory loop and identifies unconscious muscle gripping.
steps: Feel your feet making contact with the floor
Notice and unclench your jaw and release your tongue from the roof of mouth
Drop your shoulders and loosen your abdominal muscles as you exhale
caution_note: Notice without judgment.
